samples:
Is human nature fixed or can it change?
fixed / highly_changeable / slowly_changeable / no_such_thing_as_human_nature

Which gives life the most meaning?
love / work / knowledge / creativity / experiences / helping_others

Do humans deserve praise and blame for what they do?
no / yes_fully / yes_partly / only_as_a_useful_practice

Where does the meaning of a life come from?
there_is_no_meaning / it_exists_objectively / we_create_it_ourselves / relationships_with_others / contributing_to_something_bigger

Which best describes the moral nature of people when they are born?
a_mix_of_both / basically_bad / basically_good / neither_shaped_by_circumstance

Which matters more in shaping who a person becomes?
luck / genes / upbringing / all_equally / choices_they_make

Which statement about progress fits your view?
progress_comes_and_goes / progress_is_an_illusion / things_are_getting_worse / humanity_is_steadily_getting_better

Is there a single truth about how to live, or many?
a_single_truth / a_few_good_ways / no_truth_at_all / endless_valid_ways

What makes a person the same person across their life?
their_body / their_story / nothing_really / their_memories / their_personality

Do you think humans are special compared to other animals?
not_special / fundamentally_special / special_only_in_degree / less_special_than_we_think

What best describes selfishness in human nature?
people_are_mostly_selfish / people_are_mostly_generous / it_depends_on_the_situation / people_are_selfish_but_cooperative

How much do you agree that humans have genuine free will?
Every choice is fully determined by prior causes / Choices feel free but are mostly determined / Choices are partly free and partly determined / Most choices are truly free / Every choice we make is completely free

child.label: Meaning & Human Nature
child.description: Questions about what gives a life meaning or value, what is worth doing for its own sake, and what human beings are basically like, such as cooperative, cruel, or driven by emotion.
child.not_for: Free will, determinism, why anything exists, the nature of reality, and whether the universe has a purpose (use Free Will & Reality).
examples: Do we create our own meaning in life?

samples:
Is the universe indifferent to us?
cant_be_known / completely_indifferent / somehow_friendly_to_life / indifferent_but_that_is_fine

How much do you believe the universe has an underlying purpose?
It has none / Probably none / I can't tell / Probably some / It clearly has one

Which view of free will is closest to yours?
unsure / we_have_real_free_will / free_will_is_an_illusion / determined but still free in the sense that matters

Is reality basically what it appears to be?
yes_mostly / we_cant_know / no_it_is_very_different / roughly_but_with_big_gaps

If life has no built-in purpose, what follows?
nothing_really_matters / we_should_make_our_own / we_should_reduce_suffering / we_should_just_enjoy_ourselves

What is the biggest mystery humans still face?
the_nature_of_time / why_anything_exists / whether_we_are_alone / what_consciousness_is / what_happens_after_death

Which question would you most want answered for certain?
are_we_alone / is_there_free_will / what_is_reality_made_of / does_life_have_a_purpose / why_is_there_something_rather_than_nothing

Would humanity be better off knowing the answers to the biggest questions?
worse_off / much_better / no_different / a_little_better

Is it possible to live a meaningful life without asking big questions?
no / yes_easily / yes_but_its_shallower

How much does the size of the universe affect how you see your own life?
It makes my life feel pointless / It makes me feel very small / It doesn't affect how I see my life / It makes my life feel precious / It fills me with awe and purpose

How optimistic are you about humanity's long-term future?
I expect humanity to go extinct / I expect a grim future / I expect it to stay much the same / I expect a better future / I expect a wonderful future

How much do you believe that everything in the universe follows fixed laws?
Nothing does; it's all chaos / Some things do / Most things do / Everything does, without exception

child.label: Free Will & Reality
child.description: Questions about free will and determinism, why anything exists, whether reality is as it appears, and whether the universe has a purpose or cares about us.
child.not_for: What gives a person's life meaning or value and what humans are like (use Meaning & Human Nature).
examples: Do you believe in free will?
Does the universe have a purpose?
